panel_description: Kaplan-Meier survival curves for low-risk vs high-risk patients (four-DNA-methylation score) in the GEO GSE51547 cohort (n=47), with censoring ticks; paper log-rank P=3.09E-2.
transformations: From Figure 2-source data 3; keep Sample, time, status (renamed event: 1=death,0=censored), group (low-risk/high-risk).
known_missing_information: App native log-rank p=0.051 vs paper P=3.09E-2 (test-variant/tie-handling difference; KM curves identical). Paper uses dashed/solid line styles + in-panel P text; recreation uses coloured curves + a log-rank annotation.
